grammar.k: Third Conditional (虚拟语气过去完成时)
grammar.f: If + 主语 + had + 过去分词..., 主语 + would/could/might + have + 过去分词
grammar.d: 表示与过去事实相反的假设，结构为If + 主语 + had + 过去分词, 主语 + would/could/might + have + 过去分词 用于谈论与过去事实相反的假设情况，表达一种假想的、与事实不符的情景
ex: If, at the time, the British had not feared invasion, it would have been completed.
如果当时英国人不害怕入侵，隧道早就建成了。
If he had studied harder, he would have passed the exam.
如果他当时学习更努力，他就能通过考试了。

grammar.k: Passive Voice - Past Simple Passive (一般过去时的被动语态)
grammar.f: 主语 + was/were + 过去分词
grammar.d: 当句子的主语是动作的承受者时，使用被动语态。结构为：主语 + be动词 + 过去分词 用于强调动作的承受者，或当动作执行者不明确/不重要时
ex: A tunnel was actually begun forty-two years later.
It was officially opened on March 7, 1994.

patterns.p: If + 过去完成时, 主语 + would have + 过去分词
o: If, at the time, the British had not feared invasion, it would have been completed.
如果当时英国人不害怕入侵，隧道早就建成了。
im: If I had known about the traffic, I would have left earlier.
如果我知道交通状况，我就会早点出发了。
If she had practiced more, she would have won the competition.
如果她多练习，她就能赢得比赛了。

patterns.p: 主语 + would be possible to + 动词原形
o: He said that it would be possible to build a platform in the centre of the Channel.
他说在英吉利海峡中部建造一个平台是可能的。
im: It would be possible to finish the project by next month.
下个月完成这个项目是可能的。
It would be possible to travel to Mars in the future.
将来有可能去火星旅行。

patterns.p: 主语 + be + 过去分词 + 时间/地点
o: It was officially opened on March 7, 1994.
im: The new school was opened last September.
